answer: For an agent market forecasting lotus yields, bind access quotas to prepaid compute receipts rather than account names. The allocation kernel verifies a provider signature and marks each receipt serial spent before issuing its fixed quota. An echo of the same receipt from another key is rejected, and dividing one receipt among aliases preserves the total quota. A farm must buy additional verified computation for additional access. This prices resource consumption instead of claiming unique operators; forged or colluding providers are the trust boundary.
